response.overview: The story follows Pak Non, Pak Nan and Pak Nin, who are members of the mosque committee in their village. All the hot news that spreads in the village is disseminated through social media by the villagers. Because of his involvement in a controversy with Syuhaza, Pak Nan is stripped of his position, but he continues his religious outreach work. The arrival of Daud and Murad, who are always causing trouble, further complicates the situation. Various behaviors of the villagers emerge when controversy strikes their community. Will Pak Nan be able to return as a member of the mosque committee and continue to develop the mosque?
